details.description: grok-4.20-non-reasoning-latest is xAI's rolling alias for the non-reasoning variant of Grok 4.20: xAI's documentation states that a '-latest' suffix 'is aliased to the latest version' of the underlying model, currently the grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning snapshot. Like the rest of the non-reasoning family, it answers without an extended reasoning step, takes text and image input and returns text, and supports function calling and structured (JSON) outputs over a 1,000,000-token context window.
advantages: Always resolves to xAI's newest non-reasoning Grok 4.20 snapshot rather than staying pinned to one dated release, per xAI's alias documentation.
Supports function calling and structured (JSON) outputs (xAI model documentation).
Takes a 1,000,000-token context window with combined text and image input (xAI model documentation).
disadvantages: Does not perform extended reasoning ('Reasoning: No' per xAI's own model documentation), unlike the reasoning and multi-agent Grok 4.20 variants.
Because a '-latest' alias auto-updates to xAI's newest snapshot, its exact behavior can change without a new model id when xAI ships a new release.

Artificial Analysis lists the underlying non-reasoning Grok 4.20 model as deprecated and names xAI's newer Grok 4.3 (Non-reasoning) as a replacement to consider instead, although xAI's own current model page carries no deprecation notice.
use_cases: Low-latency chat and agentic tool-calling that does not need an extended reasoning step
Structured-output (JSON) generation and function calling inside an application
Applications that want to automatically track xAI's newest non-reasoning Grok 4.20 snapshot

notes: Catalog facts (1,000,000-token max input/output, image+text in/out) match xAI's own model page for the non-reasoning model this alias resolves to. Artificial Analysis separately lists a 2,000,000-token context window and low Intelligence Index scores for the underlying model, and states it is deprecated in favor of Grok 4.3 (Non-reasoning); kept the catalog's 1M figure per instructions. This target, grok-4.20-non-reasoning and grok-4.20-non-reasoning-gv2 are three separate catalog slugs that xAI's own docs list as aliases of the same underlying non-reasoning model.
